description: PostgreSQL 18 money input, cent rounding, output, arithmetic, casts, comparison, indexes, wire type, and errors
sql: SELECT '1234.56'::money AS plain, '$1,234.56'::money AS currency, '(123.45)'::money AS parentheses, '-$0.005'::money AS negative_round, '$0.005'::money AS positive_round;

SELECT 10::money + 2::money AS addition, 10::money - 2::money AS subtraction, 10::money * 2::int4 AS integer_multiply, 2::numeric * 10::money AS numeric_multiply, 10::money / 4::int4 AS scalar_divide, 10::money / 4::money AS money_ratio;
SELECT 10.129::numeric::money AS numeric_to_money, 10::money::numeric AS money_to_numeric, 10::money::text AS money_to_text;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_money (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, amount MONEY);
SELECT id, amount, amount = 2::money AS equals_two, amount > 2::money AS above_two FROM type_matrix_money ORDER BY amount;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_money WHERE amount = 10::money ORDER BY id;
SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount_sum, MIN(amount) AS amount_min, MAX(amount) AS amount_max FROM type_matrix_money;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_money_sum (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, amount MONEY);
